I replied to Hollis in a thread under their message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm ticket #6980:

- **Files:** there are no Tamsin Cold Chain account files in the shared files I can access.
- **Channel:** nothing in #central-team mentions a gate kiosk outage or that ticket number.

I said I'll treat the number as unconfirmed until someone checks it in the support queue or Tamsin confirms it in writing. I also offered to draft an internal note asking support to look it up. I only checked #central-team and the shared files, and I didn't use `search_messages`, because its results include conversations Hollis can't see.
